summary: A horizontal split case pump has its casing divided on the horizontal plane through the shaft centreline. The suction and discharge nozzles are cast into the lower half, so after removing the upper half the whole rotor (shaft, double-suction impeller, wear rings, sleeves, seals and bearings) can be lifted out without disturbing the pipework or the motor. Liquid from the side suction nozzle divides into two channels and enters the impeller from both sides; this halves the eye velocity (lower NPSH required) and balances the axial thrust. The impeller sits between two bearings, giving a stiff rotor suitable for large flows in water supply, cooling water, fire protection and pipeline service.

classification.configuration: Between bearings, axially split, double suction

model_configuration.impeller: Closed double-suction impeller with casing wear rings on both eyes
model_configuration.casing: Single volute, side suction and side discharge in the lower half; upper half with lifting eye and split-flange bolting
model_configuration.shaft_seal: Mechanical seals at both shaft exits (gland packing is a common alternative in water service)
model_configuration.bearings: Radial bearing inboard (coupling end), thrust bearing outboard
model_configuration.drive: Flexible coupling to a foot-mounted motor on a common baseplate

sc_lower.function: Lower half of the axially split casing: carries the suction and discharge nozzles, feet and bearing brackets, so the rotor can be removed without disturbing the piping.
sc_lower.construction: Cast volute (often double volute) with suction passages feeding both impeller eyes; machined horizontal split flange.
sc_lower.material: Cast iron, ductile iron, cast steel, bronze, duplex.
sc_lower.operating_conditions: Pipe loads act on this half; alignment depends on its rigidity.

sc_upper.function: Removable top half of the casing; lifting it exposes the complete rotor for inspection.
sc_upper.construction: Cast cover bolted on the horizontal split joint with a gasket; lifting eye.

impeller_ds.function: Double-suction impeller: liquid enters from both sides, halving eye velocity (lower NPSHr) and balancing axial thrust.
impeller_ds.construction: Back-to-back enclosed impeller with two eyes and wear rings on both sides.
impeller_ds.operating_conditions: Asymmetric suction piping can unbalance flow to the two eyes.

pump_shaft.function: Transmits torque from the coupling to the impeller(s).
pump_shaft.construction: Ground shaft with keyways, threads for impeller nut and bearing locknut; often protected by a sleeve under the seal.
pump_shaft.material: Carbon steel, 4140 alloy steel, 410/420 or 316 stainless, duplex.
pump_shaft.operating_conditions: Stiffness (L3/D4 ratio for overhung pumps) limits deflection at the seal faces.
failure_modes: Excess deflection when operated far from BEP

mechanical_seal.function: Seals the rotating shaft where it leaves the pressurised casing.
mechanical_seal.construction: Spring-loaded rotating face running against a stationary seat; secondary elastomer seals; cartridge designs are pre-set for easier installation.
mechanical_seal.material: Faces: carbon-graphite, silicon carbide, tungsten carbide; metal parts stainless steel; elastomers per fluid.
mechanical_seal.operating_conditions: Faces need a stable liquid film; flush or quench piping plans (API 682 plan numbers) are chosen to control temperature, pressure and solids at the faces.

bearing_frame.function: Holds the shaft bearings and oil or grease, and supports the overhung impeller.
bearing_frame.construction: Cast housing with bearing bores, oil sump with sight glass/constant-level oiler, bearing isolators or lip seals, and foot.
bearing_frame.operating_conditions: Oil level and cleanliness are critical; bearing isolators keep contaminants out.

radial_bearing.function: Carries radial load near the impeller end.
failure_modes: Overload from operation far from BEP

thrust_bearing.function: Carries axial hydraulic thrust and locates the shaft axially.
thrust_bearing.construction: Duplex angular-contact ball bearings (back-to-back) or tapered roller bearings.
thrust_bearing.material: Bearing steel; brass or polyamide cages.
thrust_bearing.operating_conditions: Thrust varies with flow and wear-ring clearance.
failure_modes: Overload from worn wear rings or balance holes

wear_ring.function: Renewable close-clearance ring that limits recirculation from discharge back to suction.
wear_ring.construction: Press-fit ring in the casing (and sometimes on the impeller); clearance per manufacturer or API 610 table.
wear_ring.material: Bronze, cast iron, hardened stainless steel; dissimilar hardness to avoid galling.
wear_ring.operating_conditions: Doubling clearance noticeably reduces efficiency and increases thrust.

coupling_flex.function: Transmits torque between motor and pump while accommodating small misalignment and allowing separation for maintenance.
coupling_flex.construction: Two hubs with a flexible element (elastomer spider, pin-and-bush, disc pack or gear); spacer versions allow seal removal without moving the motor.
coupling_flex.material: Steel or cast iron hubs; elastomer or stainless-steel disc elements.
coupling_flex.operating_conditions: Misalignment must still be corrected to manufacturer and pump tolerance; flexible couplings are not a substitute for alignment.
failure_modes: Element wear or rupture from misalignment
inspection: Laser or dial alignment after grouting, after piping connection and at operating temperature

coupling_guard.construction: Sheet-metal or mesh guard fixed to the baseplate; must be in place before start-up.
coupling_guard.material: Steel, aluminium or non-sparking brass for hazardous areas.

motor_frame_h.function: Encloses the stator and supports the bearings; feet or flange mount the motor to the baseplate or pump.
motor_frame_h.construction: Totally enclosed fan-cooled (TEFC) frame with external cooling fins, drive-end and non-drive-end end shields, terminal box and lifting eye.
motor_frame_h.material: Cast iron or aluminium frame; steel fasteners.
motor_frame_h.operating_conditions: Frame size, enclosure (IP rating), efficiency class (e.g. IEC 60034-30-1 IE3/IE4) and insulation class per motor data sheet.
failure_modes: Overheating from blocked fins or fan cover
Soft foot causing frame distortion and vibration
inspection: Check foot shims for soft foot

stator.construction: Laminated electrical-steel core with insulated copper windings; end turns project at each end.
stator.material: Silicon electrical steel, copper magnet wire, Class F/H insulation (typical).
stator.operating_conditions: Rated voltage and frequency; temperature rise within insulation class.

rotor.function: Converts the rotating field into shaft torque (squirrel-cage induction rotor).
rotor.construction: Laminated core with aluminium or copper bars and end rings, shrunk on the shaft and dynamically balanced.
rotor.material: Electrical steel, die-cast aluminium or copper.

motor_bearings.function: Support the motor rotor at drive and non-drive ends.
motor_bearings.construction: Deep-groove ball bearings (roller bearing at drive end on larger belt-driven motors); one end locates axially.
motor_bearings.operating_conditions: Regrease interval depends on speed, size and temperature; insulated bearings recommended with VFDs to prevent electrical fluting.

motor_fan.function: Draws cooling air over the finned frame.
motor_fan.construction: Shaft-mounted radial or bidirectional fan at the non-drive end.
inspection: Visual check through fan cover; clean inlet

fan_cover.function: Guards the fan and directs air along the fins.
fan_cover.construction: Pressed-steel cowl with perforated air inlet.
fan_cover.operating_conditions: Air inlet must be kept clear (minimum clearance to walls per manufacturer).

baseplate.function: Provides a rigid common mounting for pump and driver, maintains alignment and transfers loads to the foundation.
baseplate.construction: Fabricated steel channel frame with machined mounting pads, grout and vent holes, drip rim/drain, and anchor bolt holes.
baseplate.material: Carbon steel, painted; stainless steel for hygienic or corrosive areas.
baseplate.operating_conditions: Must be levelled and fully grouted (epoxy or cementitious) to achieve stiffness; ANSI/HI and API 686 give installation practice.
failure_modes: Voids under the baseplate causing vibration
inspection: Check levelness and anchor bolt tightness

pipework.function: Connects the pump to the system.
pipework.construction: Flanged pipe spools, fittings and supports; suction piping laid out to give uniform flow into the pump (straight run, eccentric reducers flat side up).
pipework.material: Carbon steel, stainless steel, ductile iron, HDPE/PVC as appropriate.
pipework.operating_conditions: Piping must be supported independently so nozzle loads stay within limits.
inspection: Check supports and flange alignment before bolting to pump

pressure_gauge.function: Indicates suction or discharge pressure for operation and performance checks.
pressure_gauge.construction: Bourdon-tube gauge with isolation valve; glycerine filled for pulsating service.
pressure_gauge.material: Stainless steel case and wetted parts.
pressure_gauge.operating_conditions: Range so that normal reading is mid-scale.
